tooltip.specialpickaxes.controls: Use: primary • Sneak-use: secondary/cancel • No recipes
message.specialpickaxes.no_target: No valid operation: check target, memory, anchors or material.
message.specialpickaxes.queued: %s steps queued. Switch tools to stop.
message.specialpickaxes.anchor_a: First anchor set. Aim at the second.
message.specialpickaxes.linked: Link active. Mining near A echoes at B.
tooltip.specialpickaxes.palimpsest: Rebuild your remembered mining scars. Each placed block consumes an actual inventory block.
tooltip.specialpickaxes.secondary.palimp: Sneak-use: Cancel selection; memory is never erased by accident
tooltip.specialpickaxes.fault_choir: Replay your recorded excavation stencil at a new anchor. Only matching rock is removed.
tooltip.specialpickaxes.eventide: Collapse a geological domain while bending hostile trajectories. No item magnet or damage explosion.
tooltip.specialpickaxes.meridian: Link two loaded anchors in one dimension. Mining near the first echoes at the second.
tooltip.specialpickaxes.paradox_crucible: Rephase inert geology one-for-one. Never creates ore, drops or experience.
tooltip.specialpickaxes.secondary.parado: Sneak-use: Cycle stone / deepslate / basalt / obsidian
tooltip.specialpickaxes.interregnum: Anchor kinetic stasis. Mining inside sustains the domain and grants ×8 local mining speed.
tooltip.specialpickaxes.worldloom: Weave a hollow shelter or bridge from actual inventory blocks. Hold the chosen rock in your offhand.
tooltip.specialpickaxes.icarus: Ride a kinetic bore. Every section is excavated before your body may advance.
tooltip.specialpickaxes.hollow_axiom: Excavate the geological matrix while preserving ore, machinery and optional structural ribs.
tooltip.specialpickaxes.bifold_atlas: Exchange two geological regions in protected atomic pairs. No matter is duplicated.
tooltip.specialpickaxes.secondary.bifold: Sneak-use: Cancel selection; sneak-left-click changes transformation
tooltip.specialpickaxes.worldbreaker: Analyze a selected world volume, then break, carve, rephase, transpose, record or restore.
tooltip.specialpickaxes.secondary.worldb: Sneak-use: Cycle operation when idle; cancel selection/job otherwise
tooltip.specialpickaxes.chronicle: Record a geological checkpoint; restore missing cells later with real materials.
tooltip.specialpickaxes.secondary.chroni: Sneak-use: Cycle operation when idle; cancel selection/job otherwise
tooltip.specialpickaxes.keystone: Build a parabolic vault defined by your selected span, rise and depth.
tooltip.specialpickaxes.secondary.keysto: Sneak-use: Cycle operation when idle; cancel selection/job otherwise
tooltip.specialpickaxes.tessellator: Reproduce an existing geological blueprint in another region, paying for every placed block.
tooltip.specialpickaxes.secondary.tessel: Sneak-use: Cycle operation when idle; cancel selection/job otherwise
message.specialpickaxes.overlap: INVALID · Source and target overlap. No operation queued.
message.specialpickaxes.incompatible: Incompatible dimensions: %s -> %s. A 90° turn swaps width and depth.
message.specialpickaxes.backpressure: Queue full. Wait for another operation to finish.
ux.specialpickaxes.controls: Use: preview; use again at the same target: confirm. Sneak-use: mode / cancel.
ux.specialpickaxes.region_controls: Use: arm selection. Left click: corners. Sneak-left: mode/transform. Use: analyze; use at READY: execute.
ux.specialpickaxes.cancel_help: While working: Use pauses/resumes; sneak-use cancels. Switching tools cancels work.
ux.specialpickaxes.resources: Paid construction/restore: plain inventory blocks. No recipes. No unloaded chunks or machines.
message.specialpickaxes.armed: SELECTING · Left click corner A, then B. Sneak-use cancels.
message.specialpickaxes.corner: Corner %s selected. Continue with left click.
message.specialpickaxes.selection_ready: READY · All corners selected. Use to analyze before committing.
message.specialpickaxes.selection_invali: INVALID · Check size, transform dimensions, overlap, range and permissions.
message.specialpickaxes.need_corners: Corners %s / %s · Left click selects the next corner.
message.specialpickaxes.unlinked: DISCONNECTED · Use to choose a new ANCHOR A.
message.specialpickaxes.confirm_again: PREVIEW · Use again here to confirm; sneak-use cancels.
message.specialpickaxes.chunk_pause: PAUSED · Next chunk is unloaded. Load it, then Use to resume.
status.specialpickaxes.anchor_b: ANCHOR A set · aim B and Use
